rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: Nothing runs that is not inside a plan the owner approved in plan mode. A request in chat gets a plan, not an action.
rules.says: A session runs nothing outside a plan the owner approved in plan mode, and a request typed in chat is answered with a plan, not with an action.
rules.enforcer: approved-plan-guard.mjs (refuses every write outside an approved plan)
rules.live_quote: Plan mode for the scope, because it gives the approve button.
rules.missing: That nothing runs outside a plan the owner approved in plan mode, and that a request typed in chat gets a plan and not an action. Live lines (running.md:46-49, piece-of-work:9, never.md:103) cover only plan mode for scope and approval by button.

rules.heading: 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: `approved-plan-guard.mjs` refuses every write outside an approved plan
rules.says: Every write outside an approved plan is refused, so a session cannot write anything that is not inside a plan the owner approved.
rules.enforcer: approved-plan-guard.mjs

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: 1. **Tell the owner in the first line, during the work, and at the end.** The first line says what is being done now and what comes next.
rules.says: The first line of a reply tells the owner what is being done now and what comes next.
rules.enforcer: The dispatcher's UserPromptSubmit reminder; the rest is judgement

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: During the work, each step says what it is and what it found, in plain terms.
rules.says: During the work, each step says in plain terms what it is and what it found.
rules.enforcer: The dispatcher's UserPromptSubmit reminder; the rest is judgement

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The end says what was done, what was not, what was found and not fixed, and what is open for the owner. It also says whether the session is paused and pending what of the owner's, running what, or finished
rules.says: The closing report says what was done, what was not done, what was found and not fixed, and what is open for the owner, and also states whether the session is paused (pending what of the owner's), running (what), or finished, in the state line rule 6 fixes.
rules.enforcer: The dispatcher's UserPromptSubmit reminder; the rest is judgement
rules.live_quote: Report what changed and what it means, in plain words, with the state at the end: finished, paused on what, or running what.
rules.missing: That the closing report says what was not done, what was found and not fixed, and what is open for the owner. Only what changed and the state line are stated. Worker report (worker.md:24) carries Found lines to the manager, not the owner's closing report.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: Process noise with no finding in it is not telling.
rules.says: Process noise that carries no finding does not count as telling the owner anything.
rules.enforcer: The dispatcher's UserPromptSubmit reminder; the rest is judgement

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: 2. **A status when an agent has ended, and what the work says in it.** A status says what changed since the last one and what it means for the work, what the session did about it, and the time remaining
rules.says: A status says what changed since the last status and what it means for the work, what the session did about it, and the time remaining, read from the run rather than guessed.
rules.enforcer: The status print of report.mjs and the dispatcher's reminder

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The time in a status is READ FROM THE CLOCK, never estimated.
rules.says: Any time given in a status is read from the clock and never estimated, because estimated times in five statuses ran forty minutes off.
rules.enforcer: The status print of report.mjs stamps the clock and writes the clock's time into the status
rules.missing: all. page.md:33 only fixes California time as the zone; no live page says a time in a status is read from the clock and never estimated.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: No app notifications, ever: statuses go in chat and on the status page.
rules.says: Never send app notifications; statuses go only in chat and on the status page.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **A status is the manager's report, never a heartbeat.** A status with nothing new says so in one line.
rules.says: A status is the manager's report and never a heartbeat, and a status with nothing new says so in one line.
rules.enforcer: The status print of report.mjs and the dispatcher's reminder

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: Findings are acted on when they arrive, not left for an agent to find at the end of its run.
rules.says: Findings are acted on the moment they arrive and are not left for an agent to find at the end of its run.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **A status falling due never stops the work:** the session gives it and carries on.
rules.says: When a status falls due, the session gives it and carries on with the work rather than stopping.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **A status is due when an agent the session launched has ended since the last one, and at no other time.**
rules.says: A status is due only when an agent the session launched has ended since the last status: not every five minutes, not while an agent merely runs, not while nothing has ended, and the status does not announce what comes next.
rules.enforcer: The status print of report.mjs and the dispatcher's reminder; no gate refuses a main-thread call for a missed status (step 58 removed that refusal)

rules.heading: 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: *Held by:* the status print of `report.mjs` and the dispatcher's reminder. No gate refuses a main-thread call for a status that is due
rules.says: The manager reads from the status print that an agent has ended and gives the status itself; nothing refuses a main-thread call for failing to give a due status, so giving it is the manager's own duty.
rules.enforcer: the status print of report.mjs and the dispatcher's reminder (no gate refuses)

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: Giving the status stamps the clock and writes the clock's time into the status. Every status the command stamps prints, each read from the agent's own transcript or from disk and never from what an agent said: each agent the session launched that has ended
rules.says: Every status is given through the command that stamps the clock, and prints each agent the session launched that has ended since the last status with how it ended (report, refusal, interruption including a restart cut-off, or failure) and its last entry, read from the agent's own transcript or disk and never from what the agent said.
rules.enforcer: report.mjs status print

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: each running agent's latest line from its progress note, `progress/step-N.txt` in the session scratchpad, flagged when the note is missing, empty or older than five minutes
rules.says: The status prints each running agent's latest line from its progress note (progress/step-N.txt in the session scratchpad), flagged when the note is missing, empty, older than five minutes, or when the agent's prompt names no plan step.
rules.enforcer: report.mjs status print

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: for each agent running or ended since the last status, every hook refusal it received and its last tool result
rules.says: The status prints, for each agent running or ended since the last status, every hook refusal it received and its last tool result.
rules.enforcer: report.mjs status print

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: and the approval state, which is the marker or none, the plan, hash and time it holds, the plan file's hash and last write, and whether the two hashes match.
rules.says: The status prints the approval state: the marker or none, the plan, hash and time it holds, the plan file's hash and last write, and whether the two hashes match.
rules.enforcer: report.mjs status print

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: Before sending the first agent under any approval the main thread gives a status and reads that print, and the dispatch gate's refusals print the same lines
rules.says: Before sending the first agent under any approval, the main thread gives a status and reads its print, and the dispatch gate's refusals print the same lines so the session can see why a send was refused.
rules.enforcer: The dispatch gate's refusals print the same lines as the status

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The manager judges an agent's work from these reads, never from its report, because the report says what the agent believes happened.
rules.says: The manager judges an agent's work from the transcript and disk reads in the status print and never from the agent's own report, which only says what the agent believes happened.
rules.enforcer: report.mjs status print; the judgement itself is not gated
rules.live_quote: Open the real output: the files, the commit, the running thing. A report of the work is not the work.
rules.missing: That the manager judges an agent's work from transcript and disk reads in the status print and never from the agent's own report. The live line binds the checker only; no status print exists.

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The judgement before a send is the wall line (Design part 2): one written sentence answering whether the step still serves the item's acceptance, whether the item still serves the thesis, and whether what was just seen moved either
rules.says: Before a send the manager writes the wall line, one sentence answering whether the step still serves the item's acceptance, whether the item still serves the thesis, and whether what was just seen moved either, placed in each agent's report after its verdict word and in the review's hand-back.
rules.enforcer: No gate (judgedGate removed at step 58); answered by the wall line and the review of a plan's first move and of every move after an eject, failure, refusal or correction

rules.heading: 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: No gate refuses a send for lacking it: step 58 of the redesign plan removed `judgedGate` from `hook-dispatch.mjs`
rules.says: No gate refuses a send for lacking the wall line, so the judgement is the manager's own to make and write; the old five-part and four-part lines were removed because they recorded that a judgement was made without showing it was sound, and the wall line plus the review of a plan's first move and of every move after an eject, failure, refusal or correction answers that.
rules.enforcer: the review (reviewGate) for the first move and moves after an eject, failure, refusal or correction; no gate for the wall line itself

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **Every status prints the pointer, and each hand-back, after the goals.** The main thread keeps no memory of the plan: it reads its next move from this print instead of choosing it.
rules.says: Every status prints the pointer and each hand-back after the goals, and the main thread keeps no memory of the plan but reads its next move from that print instead of choosing it.
rules.enforcer: report.mjs (pointerState, pointerBlock, statusPage)

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The plan's `## Order` section carries an `Order:` line of step numbers and, optionally, a `Standing:` line of steps that may be sent at any time.
rules.says: A plan's ## Order section carries an Order: line of step numbers and optionally a Standing: line of steps that may be sent at any time.
rules.enforcer: report.mjs (pointerState); plan-guard.mjs

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The first line of the print is `next: step N`, N being the first number in Order with no hand-back whose first line opens DONE, or `next: none` once every one has one.
rules.says: The pointer line reads next: step N where N is the first number in Order with no hand-back opening DONE, or next: none once every step has one; a hand-back opening REFUSED or FAILED, or an agent that ended at a refusal with no verdict word, an interruption or a failure, leaves N where it is, and a DONE hand-back counts even if a call of the agent was refused before it (the status says the word and that a call was refused).
rules.enforcer: report.mjs (pointerState, agentEnd; LESSONS 436)

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: A manager's Done line counts a step whose newest end is other than DONE, never a step no agent was sent for or one still running, and the status prints it as done by decision.
rules.says: A manager's Done line may count a step whose newest end is other than DONE, but never a step no agent was sent for or one still running, and the status prints such a step as done by decision.
rules.enforcer: report.mjs

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: A Standing step is never N.
rules.says: A Standing step is never the pointer's N.
rules.enforcer: report.mjs (pointerState)

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: Under it the print gives each step's state, the newest hand-back of each step with every line it carries and the path of its report file
rules.says: Under the pointer the status print gives each step's state, the newest hand-back of each step with every line and the path of its report file (progress/step-N-report.txt in the session scratchpad), and the Found: lines of every report file.
rules.enforcer: report.mjs (pointerBlock)

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: the same read writes the status page's source, `status/fix-run.html` in the session scratchpad: each step in Order with its state, the time of the last status in California time, the `Found:` lines, and what is open for the owner.
rules.says: Each status read also writes the status page source status/fix-run.html in the session scratchpad, showing each step in Order with its state, the time of the last status in California time, the Found: lines, and what is open for the owner.
rules.enforcer: report.mjs (statusPage)

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The print reads N; it does not announce it, so the owner still says what comes next. A plan with no `## Order` defines no pointer and the print says `next: not defined`.
rules.says: The print reads N but does not announce it, so the owner still says what comes next, and a plan with no ## Order has no pointer and the print says next: not defined.
rules.enforcer: report.mjs (pointerState, pointerBlock, statusPage)

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **Where the plan carries a review step, a fresh agent clears every move before it goes.** A plan with an `## Order` has a `Standing:` step that tells its agent to follow the live clone's `aim-review.md` by its full path
rules.says: A plan with an ## Order must have a Standing: step telling its agent to follow the live clone's aim-review.md by its full path, and a fresh review agent clears every move before it goes.
rules.enforcer: plan-guard.mjs refuses a plan with an Order and no such step; reviewGate in hook-dispatch.mjs

rules.heading: 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: and `plan-guard.mjs` refuses a plan with an Order and no such step.
rules.says: A plan that has an Order section but no Standing step naming aim-review.md is refused at plan approval.
rules.enforcer: plan-guard.mjs

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The main thread names the next move from the evidence, any step of the plan and not only N, and the review reads that move against the owner's aim and against the guards' own code.
rules.says: The main thread names the next move from the evidence, which may be any step of the plan and not only N, and the review reads that move against the owner's aim and the guards' own code.
rules.enforcer: reviewGate in hook-dispatch.mjs

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: Its hand-back is the verdict. Its first line is ON-AIM or OFF-AIM, then ROUTE-CLEAR or ROUTE-REFUSED, then `step N` for the hand-back judged and `next M` for the step whose route it read.
rules.says: The review's hand-back is the verdict, and its first line is ON-AIM or OFF-AIM, then ROUTE-CLEAR or ROUTE-REFUSED, then step N for the hand-back judged and next M for the step whose route it read.
rules.enforcer: reviewGate and reviewState (report.mjs)

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: *Enforced by:* `reviewGate` in `hook-dispatch.mjs`, which since step 58 of the redesign plan judges only the plan's first send
rules.says: A review is required before the plan's first send, the first send after a hand-back opening EJECT, FAILED or REFUSED (or an agent that ended with none), and the first send after a correction the owner typed; for those, every non-Standing step is refused unless the newest review hand-back began after every step agent's end and the plan file's last write (and the owner's newest message while a correction stands), opens ON-AIM ROUTE-CLEAR, names the step sent as next and names the newest end's step; a missing, running, stale or unreadable review refuses naming the review step, ROUTE-REFUSED refuses naming the plan amendment, OFF-AIM refuses with plan-mode wording, none of these latch, and the verdict is read from the reviewer's own transcript, never a file.
rules.enforcer: reviewGate in hook-dispatch.mjs

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: With a review step in the plan and the session's agents unreadable, no step is sent.
rules.says: When the plan has a review step and the session's agents cannot be read, no step is sent.
rules.enforcer: reviewGate in hook-dispatch.mjs

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The status prints one `Review:` line under the pointer, read by the same function (`reviewState` in `report.mjs`), so the gate and the status cannot disagree.
rules.says: The status prints one Review: line under the pointer, read by the same function the gate uses, and the pointer still names N and decides when the plan has run to its end while the review decides which step goes.
rules.enforcer: reviewState in report.mjs

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The Standing line holds the review and a route check and gains no step after approval: the marker records its numbers at approval
rules.says: The Standing line holds only the review and a route check and gains no step after approval; a Standing step not on the marker at approval, or neither the review nor a route check named in its own first line, is refused without latching, and every step including Standing ones is refused while no Standing step names aim-review.md by its full path, with a refusal saying the plan goes back through plan mode.
rules.enforcer: reviewGate and the dispatch gate in hook-dispatch.mjs (marker records Standing numbers and the review step's number)

rules.heading: 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The review step's text keeps the review file's path: the marker also records the review step's number
rules.says: The review step's text must keep the review file's path (aim-review.md by its full path), and the approval marker records the review step's number so the gates can tell whether a Standing step still names it.
rules.enforcer: reviewGate and the dispatch gate in hook-dispatch.mjs

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: Where the plan's `## Order` carries an `After:` line, groups of the form `N after M M` separated by semicolons, a review is stale only when
rules.says: Where the Order carries an After: line of groups like N after M M separated by semicolons, a review is stale only when the plan file was written after it began, a correction is newer, or the step it judged, the step it clears or a step the cleared step follows ended after it began; with no After line any end of a step in Order stales it, and an After line naming a step outside the Order is refused.
rules.enforcer: plan-guard.mjs (afterProblem); reviewState in report.mjs; LESSONS 424

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **The state of the work is one page, and the manager's part of it is kept where a status cannot rewrite it.** The status page's source, `status/fix-run.html` in the session scratchpad, is written whole at every status
rules.says: The state of the work is one page, status/fix-run.html in the session scratchpad, written whole at every status from the agents' transcripts and report files, and the manager's own part is kept separately in status/manager.txt so a status cannot rewrite it.
rules.enforcer: report.mjs (statusPage); manager fence allows the main thread to write status/manager.txt

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: What no agent's report holds, the manager writes in `status/manager.txt` beside it
rules.says: The manager writes in status/manager.txt, as plain text one item to a line, the plan's outcome in the owner's terms (Outcome:), each explanation standing or ruled out with evidence after ' | ' (Explanation standing: / Explanation ruled out:), every decision with its reason (Decision:), the next move (Next:), and a line like 'Found 41.3 queued: note' for each Found: line of a report keyed by step and place (Found 41.* sorts a whole step, and a line for one finding beats it).
rules.enforcer: managerNotes and sortFound in report.mjs; isManagerNotes in the manager fence (rule 13)

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: The page renders these under their own headings, with the Found lines in three groups, put right, stopping the plan, and queued for the next plan, and the lines not yet sorted in a fourth
rules.says: Each Found line is sorted when it lands into put right, stopping the plan, or queued for the next plan, so no unsorted finding hides, and the unsorted count shows near the top of the page and in the status print; the outcome falls back on the plan's first goal until the manager writes one.
rules.enforcer: managerNotes, sortFound and statusPage in report.mjs

rules.heading: ## 0e. PLAN MODE ONLY, AND TALK DURING THE WORK.
rules.quote: **After a compaction the main thread's first read is that page**, held the way the doctrine's read is
rules.says: After a compaction the main thread's first read is the status page; until a Read result covering the whole page, returned after the due marker, is in the transcript, every main-thread call except a read, the status and TaskStop is refused, nothing is held while the page does not yet exist, and the refusal does not latch.
rules.enforcer: markPageDue on SessionStart source compact, and pageGate in hook-dispatch.mjs
